description: Free. Find the right paid AUN utility for a task and get its x402 HTTP path and price. Covers all public utilities, including vendor.intelligence (company research, company lookup, vendor checks, supplier and KYB pre-screening from public web evidence, $0.023) and $0.001 primitives (json.validate, url.parse, text.slugify, email.normalize, uuid.validate, base64, querystring). Example: {"task":"research a vendor company website"}. Omit task for the full catalog.

budgetUsd.description: Optional maximum price per call in USD, e.g. 0.01.

task.description: Plain-language job to do, e.g. repair this JSON or research a supplier company. Omit to list all utilities.
